movelist.name: Pursuit
movelist.effect: If the foe is fleeing or being switched out, Pursuit may be used as an Interrupt, targeting the triggering foe. When used as an Interrupt, Pursuit grants the user a +5 bonus to all Movement Speeds, and has a Damage Base of 8 (2d8+10 / 19).

movelist.name: Metal Sound
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Special Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Swords Dance
movelist.effect: The user’s Attack is raised 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Fury Cutter
movelist.effect: If Fury Cutter is used successfully and consecutively on the same target, the Damage Base is increased by +4 to a maximum of 16. For example, the first hit would have a DB of 4; the second hit a DB of 8; the third hit a DB of 12; the fourth and further hits a DB of 16. If Fury Cuter misses or fails to damage its target, its Damage Base resets.

movelist.name: Autotomize
movelist.effect: For the remainder of the Encounter, the user’s Weight Class is one value lower, to a minimum of 1. If the user can, the user’s Speed is raised by +2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: No Guard
abilities.effect: The user gains a +3 bonus to all Attack Rolls; however all foes gain a +3 Bonus on Attack Rolls against the user.

abilities.name: Hyper Cutter
abilities.effect: The user’s Attack Stat may not be lowered, and its Attack Combat Stages may not be lowered. Defensive.
